metadata.Name: FQuAD2.0
metadata.Description: A French question answering dataset with 80,000 questions including 17,000+ unanswerable adversarial questions
metadata.Paper Title: FQuAD2.0: French Question Answering and knowing that you know nothing
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: We introduce FQuAD2.0, a French Question Answering dataset with both answerable questions (coming from FQuAD1.1) and 17,000+ newly annotated unanswerable questions, for a total of almost 80,000 questions. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first French adversarial Question Answering dataset. We trained various baseline models using CamemBERT architectures. Our best model, a fine-tuned CamemBERT LARGE, reaches 83% F1 score and 82.3% F1 no ans, the latter measuring its ability to distinguish answerable questions from unanswerable ones.
